[[Al Khaleej Club]] | continentalcup1 = | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | league topscorer = [[Fernando Baiano]] (25) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = | nextseason = |average attendance = }} The '''2008–09 [[UAE Pro League]] season''' was the 34th edition of top level football in the [[United Arab Emirates]] and started on 19 September 2008 until 24 May 2009. [[Shabab Al Ahli Club|Al-Ahli]] clinched the championship on the last day of the season, also qualifying for the [[2009 FIFA Club World Cup]] as the host representative. [[Al Shabab Al Arabi Club (Dubai)|Al-Shabab]] were defending champions from the 2007–08 campaign. [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] and [[Hatta Club|Hatta]] were relegated from the previous season. [[Ajman Club|Ajman]] and [[Khor Fakkan Club|Al-Khaleej]] were promoted from the second level.
